verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes an implementation-relevant report-copy rule requiring the rendered assessment-date placeholder to be replaced with an actual date or clean editable placeholder.
First concrete failure: the reviewed report contains raw assessment-date placeholder text that does not satisfy the requested copy policy.
The client specifies the rendered assessment-date field and approved replacement text for two page-two sentences; all updates affect report content, and no prior top-level key becomes obsolete.
Distinct failure evidence from an updated report: the date placeholder has a new malformed form, and two additional concrete copy defects are observed.
